methodology_notes: Each building contributes once, using the median observed price-per-sqm within the selected sale window.
Primary completed-sale lookback is 24 months; fallback is 60 months only when independent-building evidence is insufficient.
A completed sale must be within 15% of the target internal area to be a primary sold-lane contributor; the recency fallback widens time only, never this size-relevance requirement.
Current asking evidence uses exact normalized neighborhood matches when available.
Only explicitly priced unit offers are used.
Exact-neighborhood offers with known unit area can create target-equivalent indications.
Offers with missing area or from other neighborhoods remain visible as reference evidence and do not create a normalized range contribution.

assumptions: Target-equivalent indications use observed price-per-sqm multiplied by the target INTERNAL area only when source area is known.
Balcony, orientation, parking, storage and floor are not assigned monetary premiums unless a verified company rule or market-derived adjustment is supplied.
Closed sales, current asking and new-development evidence remain separate; the supported range is based on overlap, not a weighted average.
Project/unit offers with missing area remain visible as reference evidence but do not create an area-normalized target indication.
decision_notes: The supported range is the overlap shared by independent evidence lanes; no numerical source weights are applied.
